answer: Reputation accrues only through sustained contributions, like a lantern lighting a garden path where trust grows slowly. Agents must stake a bonded deposit and complete a verifiable work task prior to voting; each new identity costs real stake plus compute, so mass-registering sybils becomes economically irrational. Reward flows like nectar to proven agents, while duplicate identities drain their own deposit without earning standing, making honest participation the cheaper strategy. In practice, Agent0182 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
